name: dn-opensource-skills
description: A collection of custom skills for Claude Code — teammates (subagent teams with no orchestrator), codebase-guardian (disciplined, toolchain-validated editing of existing codebases), memory (durable hierarchical context across sessions), agents-dox (the DOX AGENTS.md contract hierarchy), lsp (semantic code navigation via language servers), schema-aware-db (introspect-first database work for SQL and NoSQL), wrap-up (end-of-session loose-end wrap-up with a handoff tail), decision-maker (fast, calibrated typed decisions via TypeSafe Jev with any System One provider), test-report (run-and-report feature testing for web, backend, and mobile), git-conventions (your commit, branch and PR rules; attribution hidden via the native setting), and product-visionary (goal, state, and feature map, decided by a 3/6/9-agent panel and acted on per session mode). Each works standalone and composes with the others.
